§7.2.6 Inline Equations

📄 Page rule — applied from the page alone

text-inline-equations · text formatting math

✅ Normative

Every equation MUST be written as LaTeX inside $$ … $$, inline ones included. Single-$ delimiters MUST NOT be used.

the coefficient $$\alpha$$ is fixed

The same delimiters apply whether the equation sits in the middle of a sentence or on a line of its own; there is no separate inline form. Displayed equations and their numbers are covered in Displayed Equations§7.2.2.

Why double delimiters

A lone $ is ambiguous. Notebook and Markdown renderers treat an unrelated currency sign further down the page as the closing delimiter, open an unterminated maths span and swallow everything after it. Doubling the delimiter removes the ambiguity. It is non-standard for inline maths, and that cost is accepted.
